newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance shares rise on earnings hope.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance shares rise on earnings hope.

text.p: Shares of financing and property concern DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd topped the most actively traded stock by turnover as they rose on expectation of an exceptional gain on the sale of a subsidiary, brokers said.
DC Finance shares rose HK$0.10 to HK$4.85 in late-morning on volume of 30.48 million shares worth HK$145.02 million.
"Expectation the company's earnings will be boosted by its possible exceptional profit of HK$43 million from the sale of its unit fueled buying," said a trader at regional brokerage.

DC Finance said it would generate a net profit of about HK$43 million following sale of its wholly-owned Jalton Profits Ltd, which indirectly owns a residential property at Kadoorie Hill in Hong Kong's Kowloon district.

In August, the company reported an interim profit of HK$78.99 million, including an exceptional gain of HK$65.60 million on sale of a subsidiary and an associated company, for the six months to June 30, 1996.
